description: A token in the AP2 SDK's shape whose signed JSON writes "max":10.0 (budget), "max":250.00 (amount_range) and "exp":1700003600.0 (payload): literals with a zero fractional part. 1.7.2 (SPEC §3.1, the SD-JWT layer), default policy: that artifact's error (float '1700003600.0' in the SD-JWT), both verifiers — JSON Schema Core 2020-12 §6.3: such a literal SHOULD NOT be written. The same pack under accept_integral_floats is sd_number_integral_literal_accepted.
